question: Will Piura's cumulative 2026 dengue death toll exceed 8 by October 15, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Piura stands at 7 confirmed 2026 dengue deaths (Diresa, data through Sep 23; reports through ~Oct 2), flat since SE35-36. YES needs 2 more deaths to appear on the CDC-MINSA dashboard by Oct 15 (~10 days). Recent death accrual is ~1 per 3 weeks; with ~700-1,000 new cases/week and a case-fatality rate near 0.06%, expected new reported deaths in the window are ~0.5-0.8, so P(>=2) is about 10-17% under Poisson. The national dashboard can lag Diresa (Infobae citing national data showed 6 on Sep 22 while Diresa had 7), which pushes down. Deaths under investigation and the lag of deaths behind cases push up. No market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.
calls.dossier:
- Diario Correo (Sep 27, 2026): Diresa Piura report with data through Sep 23 gives 11,233 cumulative 2026 cases and 7 deaths; death toll 'se mantiene' (unchanged); incidence 51.2 per 10,000. 2025 full year: 1,162 cases. 2023: 79,643 cases and 148 deaths.
- La Republica (Sep 21, 2026): through SE36, 10,656 cases and 7 deaths (4 girls from Tambogrande x2, Las Lomas and Chulucanas; plus a young person from Veintiseis de Octubre and adults from Tambogrande and Chulucanas). About 1,000 symptomatic patients in SE35 alone. Piura, Morropon and Sullana provinces hold >90% of cases.
- Infobae (Sep 22, 2026): citing MINSA/national data, Piura had 10,009 cases and 6 deaths; national total 52,395 cases and 63 deaths. This shows national and Diresa counts can differ or lag (6 vs 7).
- Noticias Piura 3.0: earlier report of 8,958 cases and 6 deaths; then 7 deaths.
- Death trajectory: 6 deaths at SE33 (late Aug), 7 by SE35-36 (mid-Sep), still 7 in reports through ~Oct 2. Roughly 1 death in the last ~4-5 weeks.
- Cases: about 700-1,000 per week and rising; cumulative case-fatality rate ~0.06%.
- Historical comparison: Piura had 28 deaths by early Oct 2024 (Infobae Oct 3, 2024), 148 in 2023 and 33 in 2017.
- Status quo: 7 deaths. Resolution needs 9 or more.
- Resolves off the CDC-MINSA sala situacional dengue dashboard (dge.gob.pe, which redirects to app7.dge.gob.pe/maps/sala_metaxenica) read on Oct 15, 2026, not off Diresa press reports. Diresa is used only if the dashboard is unavailable.
- Event window: cumulative 2026 figure read on Oct 15, 2026. As of Oct 5, about 10 days remain for 2 more deaths to be reported.
- Searched without success: the dashboard's current Piura figure (fetch returned no readable content), any October 2026 report of an 8th death, deaths under investigation. No prediction market found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers.

calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) whether an 8th death had been reported by early Oct — checked via two searches ('fallecidos octubre 2026', 'octavo fallecido'); none found, latest is 7 (Sep 23 data). (2) whether the CDC dashboard shows 6 or 7 — a national CDC search returned the Sep 12 national ranking (San Martín 18, Lambayeque 14, Madre de Dios 8) with Piura fourth per Correo, consistent with 7 or fewer; not directly resolved. (3) Lag and plateau-versus-rising-cases weighting is judgment: the lag shortens the effective window, so I side with Runs 1-2 over Run 3's upward lag adjustment. Final 0.14.
